## Overview

**Dun'vis** is a Shadow Elf who was chosen as a child to replace **Vaelis Zandorian (Zan)** after the Zandorion family secretly abandoned Zan to protect him. An orphan taken in by the Zandorions, Dun'vis was trained, modified, and shaped to become Zan -- to wear his name, bear his mark, and live his life.

But Dun'vis was never truly accepted. He was a replacement, a stand-in, a puppet. Now he hunts the real Zan, driven by a single, burning purpose: to get his own life back.

---

## Appearance

Dun'vis bears a striking physical resemblance to Zan -- the Zandorion family chose him specifically for this. Same lean build, same pale grey skin, same silver-white hair. His eyes, however, burn with a colder fire -- not pale violet like Zan's, but a hard silver-grey. A tattoo of the **Raven Queen's brand** sits on his body in the same place Zan's natural brand appeared. He dresses in dark, functional clothing, favoring mobility and concealment.

---

## Background

### The Orphan's Fate

Dun'vis grew up in the shadow-city of the Shadar-kai, an orphan with no family and no future. When the Zandorion family needed to replace their vanished son, they searched for a child who resembled Vaelis closely enough to pass as him. Dun'vis was chosen.

### Erasure

His training began immediately. He was taught to walk like Vaelis, speak like Vaelis, like the same foods, study the same subjects, laugh at the same jokes. He was given a tattoo of the Raven Queen's brand -- a mark he never earned -- so that none would question his status. He was told that from now on, his name was Vaelis Zandorian. Dun'vis was to be forgotten.

### A Life of Danger

The brand that was meant to protect the Zandorions instead became a target on Dun'vis's back. Higher families, envious of the Zandorion bloodline and the Queen's favor, sent assassins. Kidnappers tried to take him. Rivals mocked him at every opportunity. He learned to fight, to defend himself, to survive -- not because anyone taught him, but because he had no choice.

### The Zandorions' Guilt

Ashura Zando and Athena Orion were not cruel to Dun'vis -- but they were not kind either. They were haunted by what they had done to their true son. Sometimes their guilt surfaced as cold distance. Sometimes as misplaced anger. Dun'vis felt their pain but could never understand its source. He only knew he was not truly wanted -- he was tolerated, a living reminder of a decision they could never take back.

### The Truth Emerges

Over time, through whispers, oblique references, and a few drunken confessions from household staff, Dun'vis pieced together the truth: he was a replacement. The real Vaelis Zandorian was alive somewhere. The Zandorions had abandoned him -- and Dun'vis was the decoy meant to keep the hunters away from the true heir.

### The Hunt Begins

The revelation shattered Dun'vis. His entire existence was a lie. Every beating he took, every assassin he fought off, every sleepless night -- none of it was for him. It was all for a ghost, a boy he had never met, a name that was never his.

Now Dun'vis hunts Zan with a cold, relentless obsession. He wants to find him, drag him back to the Shadowfell, expose the Zandorion family's plan, and reclaim his own identity. He does not want to kill Zan -- he wants to prove that Dun'vis exists, that he matters, that his suffering was not meaningless.

---

## Driving Quote

> *"I want my life back. I want my name back. I want myself back."*

---

## Goals

1. Find Vaelis Zandorian (Zan)
2. Expose the Zandorion family's secret abandonment
3. Reclaim his own identity and name
4. End the life of a puppet
